item.title: Special Weather Bulletin No. 02: Depression in East central Bay, 25 Oct 2026
item.description:
The Depression over Eastcentral Bay and adjoining Southeast Bay moved Southeastwards over the same area and was centred near lat. 15.2°N and lon. 91.0°E at 06 AM today (25 October, 2026), about 785 km South of Chattogram, 700 km South of Cox's Bazar, 820 km South of Mongla and 760 km South of Payra.
It is likely to move southwards, intensify into a Deep Depression today (25 October, 2026) over the Eastcentral and adjoining Southeast Bay and then gradually recurve west-northwestwards. It is likely to intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm and cross Andhra Pradesh coasts by 28 October, 2026.
Maximum sustained wind speed within 44 km of the Depression centre is about 40 kph rising to 50 kph in gusts/squalls. Sea will remain moderate near the Depression centre.
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Heavy Rainfall Warning - Cox's Bazar, Bandarban, Rangamati, Khagrachhari, Chattogram - 29.09.2026
item.description: Under the influence of Land Depression over Myanmar and adjoining Northeast Bay, heavy (44-88mm/24hours) to very heavy (>88mm/24hours) rainfall is likely to occur at places over Cox's Bazar, Bandarban, Rangamati, Khagrachhari and Chattogram districts during next 48 hours commencing 06 PM of today (29.09.2026).
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Special Bulletin 05 - Deep Depression - North Bay - 23.09.2026
item.description: The Deep Depression over west-central and adjoining northwest Bay of Bengal has moved westwards and now lies over northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining west-central Bay (18.1°N, 84.8°E). It was located at 06 AM today (23 September 2026) about 900 km southwest of Chattogram, 880 km southwest of Cox's Bazar, 720 km south-southwest of Mongla and 750 km south-southwest of Payra seaport. It is likely to move further west-northwestwards and cross north Andhra Pradesh - south Odisha coast tonight (23 September 2026). Under its influence, Maritime Ports, North Bay of Bengal and adjoining coastal areas of Bangladesh may experience squally weather. Maximum sustained wind speed within 48 km of the deep depression center is about 50 km/h, rising to 60 km/h in gusts or squalls. Sea is rough near the deep depression center.
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Special Bulletin No. 02 - Depression North Bay - 22.09.2026
item.description: The Depression over west-central Bay of Bengal and adjoining area has moved west-southwestwards and lies over the same area (17.9°N, 86.4°E). It was located at 06 AM today (22 September 2026) about 768 km southwest of Chattogram, 735 km southwest of Cox's Bazar, 620 km south-southwest of Mongla and 630 km south-southwest of Payra seaport. It is likely to move further west-southwestwards and intensify into a Deep Depression within next 12 hours. Under its influence, Maritime Ports, North Bay of Bengal and adjoining coastal areas of Bangladesh may experience squally weather. Maximum sustained wind speed within 44 km of the depression center is about 40 km/h, rising to 50 km/h in gusts or squalls. Sea is rough near the depression center.
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Special Bulletin 01 - Depression - North Bay - 21.09.2026
item.description: The well-marked low over west-central and adjoining east-central Bay of Bengal has moved west-northwestwards and intensified into a Depression over west-central and adjoining northwest Bay of Bengal (17.8°N, 87.7°E). It was located at 09 PM today (21 September 2026) about 670 km southwest of Chattogram, 625 km southwest of Cox's Bazar, 660 km south-southwest of Mongla and 550 km south-southwest of Payra seaport. It is likely to move further west-northwestwards and intensify. Under its influence, Maritime Ports, North Bay of Bengal and adjoining coastal areas of Bangladesh may experience squally weather. Maximum sustained wind speed within 44 km of the depression center is about 40 km/h, rising to 50 km/h in gusts or squalls. Sea is rough near the depression center.
